subject: Wellshire deployment qualification & evidence plan
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Murray <alex.murray@wellshirehealth.com>, Sana Patel <sana.patel@wellshirehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-09T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Wellshire deployment qualification & evidence plan

Alex / Sana — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement and security have a clear path: 

Recap (what we heard)
- Wellshire will process PHI for clinical triage; HIPAA/BAA is required.
- Primary preference: Dedicated capacity (VPC) if procurement can accept a reserved commitment; otherwise Hosted with BAA and compensating controls.
- Audit team will require SOC 2 Type II artifacts, pen-test summary, data flow diagram, and 12-month retention of access/audit logs.

Tradeoffs (brief)
- Hosted + BAA: fastest onboarding (3–4 weeks), Redwood provides SOC2 artifacts and support for evidence collection; limited network isolation compared to VPC.
- Dedicated (VPC): isolates workload to a dedicated GPU pool with customer-configured VPC peering; 6–8 week delivery for onboarding + network approvals.
- Private/on-prem: supports air-gapped environments and custom KMS/HSM, but requires longer integration and on-prem ops (timeline varies).

Action items / asks from Wellshire
1) Please confirm your prioritized requirement: (A) Network isolation (VPC/dedicated) vs (B) Time-to-production (Hosted+BAA). Reply with single-letter preference.
2) Provide primary auditor contact or scoping doc for SOC2 evidence (if available).
3) Procurement: rough target for signed SOW / PO (date) so we can align rollout milestones.

What Redwood will deliver this week
- SOC2 Type II report and summary (attached stub: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf).
- Template evidence checklist and ETA for each artifact.
- Proposed mutual action plan (MAP) once you confirm prioritized path.

If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-minute security deep-dive this week with our security lead (Lauren) and Karthik for architecture review.

Thanks — I’ll wait for your preference (A/B) and auditor contact to move forward.

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (summary stub)]

From: Alex Murray <alex.murray@wellshirehealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sana Patel <sana.patel@wellshirehealth.com>, procurement@wellshirehealth.com
Date: 2028-05-10T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Wellshire deployment qualification & evidence plan

Priyom — thank you, this is exactly the level of detail we need. Quick answers from our side: 

1) Preference: B (Network isolation preferred, but procurement is pushing for Dedicated/VPC due to central IT policy; if dedicated costs are prohibitive we will consider Hosted+BAA with compensating controls).
2) Auditor contact: Melissa Huang (melissa.huang@auditalliance.com) — she will be the SOC2 point of contact.
3) Procurement target: aiming for PO delivered by 2028-06-15. Budget approval expected week of 2028-05-22.

Can your team confirm the expected lead time for Dedicated (VPC) onboarding including security review windows? Also: our security team asked whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS keys for Dedicated instances, and what the default log retention policy is for audit logs.

Appreciate the quick follow-up — Alex

On May 9, 2028, at 2:22 PM, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alex / Sana — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement and security have a clear path: 
> ...

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Murray <alex.murray@wellshirehealth.com>, Sana Patel <sana.patel@wellshirehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-10T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Wellshire deployment qualification & evidence plan

Alex — thanks, helpful. Short answers below and a proposed MAP with owners/dates.

Answers to asks
- Dedicated (VPC) lead time: baseline 6 weeks from contract signature for our standard Dedicated onboarding (includes infra provisioning, VPC peering config, and basic security runbook). Security deep-dive typically scheduled in week 1 of onboarding.
- Customer-managed KMS: Supported for Dedicated and Private deployments. We integrate with common KMS providers (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) and can sign an addendum for KMS controls if required.
- Audit log retention: Default retention for Hosted is 90 days in the console; for Dedicated we can configure up to 24 months retention and deliver export feeds to your S3 bucket or SIEM. We'll note the 12-month requirement you mentioned — that is feasible for Dedicated.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP)
- 2028-05-11: Security deep-dive (30m) — Lauren (Redwood) + Karthik to attend; Wellshire security (Melissa / Sana). Owner: Lauren.
- 2028-05-22: Finalize SOW/cost estimate for Dedicated vs Hosted+BAA. Owner: Priyom.
- 2028-06-01: Contract sign target (if budget approved). Owner: procurement@wellshirehealth.com.
- 2028-06-15: Provision Dedicated environment (if chosen) and hand over to Wellshire network team for final peering tests. Owner: Redwood infra ops.

Next steps for us now
1) I’ll schedule the security deep-dive for 2028-05-11 and share a calendar invite.
2) Lauren will prepare a short KMS & audit-log spec doc and an example S3 export pipeline.
3) Marissa will send the evidence checklist with estimated delivery dates for each artifact.

If that timeline looks ok I’ll also attach a DocuSign term sheet highlighting the KMS option and retention SLAs so procurement has an initial doc to review.

Best,
Priyom
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Murray <alex.murray@wellshirehealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-11T08:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Wellshire deployment qualification & evidence plan — evidence checklist

Alex / Team — adding the evidence-level details you asked for. Attached is a checklist (redwood-evidence-checklist.csv) with estimated delivery windows. Highlights below: 

- SOC2 Type II report: available now (latest cycle); full report delivery within 2 business days after NDA if requested.
- Pen test summary: high-level summary available today; full remediation timeline available within 5 business days.
- Data flow diagram & DPIA: we can provide a standard data flow and adapt it for your deployment; estimated 3 business days for customization for Dedicated.
- Audit logs: export feed to customer S3 within 7 business days of Dedicated provisioning; retention configurable up to 24 months.
- KMS notes: for Dedicated we support customer-managed keys; required paperwork is a KMS access and key-management addendum (we will provide template).

Attachments included: redwood-evidence-checklist.csv (stub), docusign-maplink.url (DocuSign term sheet stub).

If helpful I can also create a short one-pager that maps each audit ask to the exact artifact and owner at Redwood. Priyom — looping you to confirm we should send the formal evidence packet to Melissa at auditalliance.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
